description: Header file defining the interface for wpaCtrlConnection, including data structures, function prototypes, and constants related to WPA control connection management in nl80211.

classes.name: wpaCtrlConnection_t
classes.description: Structure representing a WPA control connection, including socket addresses, user data, event handlers, and directory path.

classes.name: wld_wpaCtrlConnection_evtHandlers_cb
classes.description: Structure holding callback functions for WPA control connection events.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlConnection_init
methods.description: Initializes a WPA control connection object with specified server path and socket name.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlConnection_setEvtHandlers
methods.description: Sets event handlers and user data for the connection.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlConnection_sendCmd
methods.description: Sends a command over the WPA control connection.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlConnection_sendCmdSyncedExt
methods.description: Sends a command and waits for a reply with extended options.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlConnection_sendCmdSynced
methods.description: Sends a command and waits for a reply.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlConnection_sendCmdCheckResponseExt
methods.description: Sends a command and checks for an expected response with extended options.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlConnection_sendCmdCheckResponse
methods.description: Sends a command and checks for an expected response.

methods.name: wld_wpaCtrlConnection_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up and deallocates the WPA control connection object.
